title: Core dump in file_search.c when searching file with [I and large &path

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- `nvim --version`: NVIM v0.5.0-522-g044eb56ed
- `vim -u DEFAULTS` (version: ) behaves differently? 
- Operating system/version: archlinux

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

```
nvim --clean
:set path=,,./*;,**2;,/usr/include
:e vendor/tree-sitter/lib/include/tree_sitter/api.h
/TSTree<CR>
[I
```

### Actual behaviour
 - core dump

### Expected behaviour
 - file search
